metaDescription: From quote to delivery in six steps. Discover how Mcars handles your car transport — personal, with a CMR consignment note and clear agreements.

steps.title: Request a quote
steps.body: You request your transport via the website, by phone or via WhatsApp. You will receive a personal reply within 24 hours with the price and the possible schedule.

steps.title: Quote approval
steps.body: Happy with the price and the schedule? Then you give the green light and we set your transport in motion. No obligations until you confirm.

steps.title: Scheduling the transport
steps.body: Once you have approved, we agree the collection date together. On the day itself, the driver calls when he will arrive, so you don’t have to miss out on anything.

steps.title: Collection + inspection & CMR documents
steps.body: We collect your car wherever you like. On site, we draw up the CMR consignment note and inspect and photograph the vehicle as internal evidence of its condition at departure.

steps.title: Delivery on location
steps.body: We call when we arrive at the delivery address. Delivery to our depot in Roeselare is possible 24/7 and is generally cheaper than home delivery.

steps.title: Payment / invoice
steps.body: Private customers pay before collection, businesses simply by invoice. We agree the practical arrangements clearly with you beforehand.

cmr.title: Proves the collection
cmr.body: The CMR consignment note shows in black and white that your car was collected by Mcars, when and where. Certainty for both parties.

cmr.title: Documents the condition
cmr.body: At collection, we record the condition of the vehicle with photos. That way its condition at departure is registered beyond dispute.

cmr.title: Important in a claim
cmr.body: Should there ever be a dispute or damage, the CMR with the recorded condition is the point of reference. Calmly sorted out in advance.

faq.a: Only a CMR consignment note is needed, and we draw it up at collection. That way you immediately have proof that your car was collected by Mcars.

faq.q: Does my car have to run to be collected?
faq.a: No. Cars that can roll we pull onto the transporter with the winch. If the car is completely locked, we provide a forklift on site. Please state the condition in your request.

faq.q: Can I have it delivered to or collected from your depot?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery and collection at our depot in Roeselare is possible 24/7 and is generally cheaper than at home. Handy if you want to be flexible.
